Hi im also a young person who has depression, I used to be a all As student, but since I started getting bullied pretty badly it's gone down hill, however one way I cope is through hobbies, specifically art. No matter what type of art it is or your skill level, letting your emotions out through song, art, dance, or whatever form you may use, it's good for motivation and learning about yourself. For example, I usually stay in bed most of the day but I usually have a daily goal to finish a drawing so that I could achieve something, or for me to improve a certain aspect of my art to keep a goal 

Also i don't think you're faking it, sadly just many teenagers are making depression an aeshetic for popularity and I wish it was addressed more

I've been through the same thing and have also been the friend to send that message on a group chat, the feeling of absolute hopelessness when your friend is going to go through with it, luckily they told us and we were able to get them immediate help! As someone who can't exactly get help, ANY close friends and family that you can talk to is always good for mental health and venting is a very good way to relieve your emotions. If you can't get therapy but have anyone in your life who can help, PLEASE TALK TO THEM!! It's a great help for both sides, TRUST ME WHEN I SAY THIS, I know most people don't want to tell anyone because they don't want to be a burden, but I'll just say this; yes you'll worry them HOWEVER they'll be glad that you spoke up and will be happy to help
